articles.summary: In the world of engineering, technical drawings function as the universal language that allows ideas to be materialized. Its main objective is to provide all the necessary information as clearly as possible to manufacture and assemble the parts represented in the drawing.
articles.title: Section View Drawings - Uncovering What's Hidden

articles.summary: Learn how to read and apply weld symbols on engineering drawings. Covers AWS and ISO standards, symbol anatomy, and common specification mistakes.
articles.title: Using Weld Symbols on Drawings: A Practical Guide
